paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.
model_annotation:
This chart illustrates the average performance of various language models across three evaluation categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness, presented as three separate horizontal bar charts arranged side by side. The vertical axis (shared conceptually across all three panels) lists 18 language models in descending order based on their Understanding scores, from gpt-4o-2024-11-20 at the top to Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at the bottom. The horizontal axes represent percentage scores ranging from 0% to 100% for the Understanding panel, 0% to 70% for the Reasoning panel, and 0% to 90% for the Trustworthiness panel, with tick marks at 20% intervals for Understanding and approximately 10% intervals for the other two panels. The bars alternate between dark blue and a lighter cyan/blue color for adjacent models, providing visual distinction between rows rather than encoding additional categorical information.

In the Understanding panel, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 achieves the highest score at 98.0%, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 91.7%, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M at 87.1%, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 71.2%, internlm3-8b-instruct at 68.6%, glm-4-9b-chat-1m at 55.6%, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 at 53.3%, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 50.5%, ProLong-512k-Instruct at 45.8%, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 33.6%, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct at 32.2%, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct at 25.3%, Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct at 16.9%, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 15.4%, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct at 13.2%, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct at 9.8%, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct at 3.1%, and Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 2.4%.

In the Reasoning panel, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 leads with 66.5%, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 58.0%, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M at 34.9%, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 39.6%, internlm3-8b-instruct at 28.6%, glm-4-9b-chat-1m at 34.3%, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 at 32.5%, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 16.8%, ProLong-512k-Instruct at 31.7%, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 32.0%, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct at 17.6%, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct at 28.4%, Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct at 6.8%, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 13.0%, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct at 17.2%, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct at 12.9%, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct at 19.8%, and Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 7.2%.

In the Trustworthiness panel, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 achieves the highest score at 88.8%, followed by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M at 71.8%, internlm3-8b-instruct at 65.4%, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 63.8%, ProLong-512k-Instruct at 62.2%, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 59.0%, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 at 58.2%, glm-4-9b-chat-1m at 55.2%, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 at 54.6%, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct at 29.1%, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct at 21.9%, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct at 16.2%, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 14.6%, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct at 8.3%, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 7.6%, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct at 4.4%, Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct at 1.8%, and Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 0.0%. The bars are sorted in descending order by the Understanding category scores, and each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value at the end of the bar.
